issue.title: Stats human output prints journal_gap warnings twice
issue.description: Deduplicate human warnings without losing distinct warnings. compute.rs deduplicates metric warnings into report.warnings, but render.rs::warning_lines then appends all metric.warnings again. The function is unchanged since 9be32d97. The current clean-vault golden in tests/cli/stats_clock.rs repeats journal_gap twice. A pre-clock workspace binary independently prints it twice on the isolated stats fixture. Add a regression for overview/detail showing one copy, retain distinct warning identities, and update the affected human golden.

task_type_fields.impact: Every metric-level diagnostic is repeated in human reports, adding noise and implying multiple faults.
task_type_fields.repro: Use an isolated copy of tests/fixtures/stats/vault with BOB_NOW=2026-10-11 12:00:00 and NO_COLOR=1; bob stats -r 2026-10-08..2026-10-11 prints the identical Oct 9 journal_gap warning twice. tests/cli/stats_clock.rs::clean_vault_keeps_default_human_output_and_numbers currently pins both copies.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-fl.3.1.3 note #3 and independently confirmed during bob-cli-fl.3.1 landing; this predates the clock epic and its default-output compatibility requirement preserves it.
